leftEvidence.title: Sirach says sin began from a woman

points.label: Agent named
points.left: Sirach’s warnings about marriage culminate in the claim that sin began from a woman and that because of her all die.
points.right: Paul says sin entered through one man and death through sin, then names Adam and describes death reigning from Adam to Moses.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam in wisdom and reflection · analytical context · Sirach 25:21–26
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · Romans 5:12–14

payload.posture: Sin began from a woman, and because of her all die is held beside Sin entered through one man, and death through sin.

rightEvidence.title: Romans traces sin and death through one man

payload.tension: The two later sources identify a woman and one man when describing how sin or death reaches all.
payload.title: Later sources name the beginning of sin differently
